purpose: Research corpus for geographic region names, especially unaffiliated Iron Arachne regions. Not runtime generator data.

feist.author: Raymond E. Feist
feist.period: 1980s core; reference covers later works too
feist.evidence: Author-approved atlas archive; gazetteer text inspected. Individual first-book appearances not established.

williams.author: Tad Williams
williams.evidence: Visually inspected author-hosted map bearing 1988 copyright and The Dragonbone Chair title. Articles normalized away.

mckiernan.author: Dennis L. McKiernan
mckiernan.evidence: Visually inspected map by Jack R. Cook, hosted on a site stating maps used with permission. Era of each label not established. Barrens and Untamed Lands also visible on the site's world map.

brooks.author: Terry Brooks
brooks.evidence: Matted Brakes and Wilderun confirmed in publisher-associated reread; other four names in Google Books index of The Sword of Shannara. Not a first-edition map inspection.

eddings.author: David Eddings
eddings.evidence: Secondary, community-maintained place index. Geographic names selected; no first-edition map inspection.

dragonlance.author: Dragonlance setting / multiple authors
dragonlance.evidence: Secondary wiki entry inspected. Geographic place, with political history; not evidence of permanent lack of ownership.
